caption:
Hack squat: 3 cues that change everything 👇

1️⃣ Back and hips stay on the pad — the whole rep
2️⃣ Knees track over your toes, push through the whole foot
3️⃣ Go down slowly, as deep as you can while your hips stay on the pad. No bouncing at the bottom.

Strong legs for every year ahead 💪
Do you go deep — or stop halfway?
Comment "START" and I'll help you start.

#hacksquat #legday #strengthtrainingforwomen #personaltrainersingapore #womenover40
